shots.content: Tube upside-down dispensing a lavender ribbon onto the back of a hand; cap and opening are ambiguous and read as a spout.
shots.note: L3 'But the real test is how it blends.' PS03 clip 0-1.33 s: MEERA's fingertips start rubbing the lavender dollop smooth, with the capped tube (no nozzle) behind. A blending visual for a blending line.

shots.content: Hand with a thick, paint-like lavender smear, with tube/box in the background, under the 'NO PURPLE RESIDUE' super.
shots.note: L4 'No chalkiness, no purple residue, and no white cast.' PS08 clip 2.3-5.0 s (2.7 s): rubbing -> the lavender vanishes completely -> even, radiant patch with no cast. The super now matches the picture.

shots.content: Creator facing camera with large thick lavender dollops on forehead, nose and chin, starting to blend.
shots.note: L5 'It's made for Indian skin and feels lightweight once absorbed.' PS04 clip 0-3.06 s: five small neat dots on MEERA's dusky face, with blending starting. No thick mask look.

shots.content: Extreme close-up of cheek with visible spots/texture and a niacinamide molecule overlay.
shots.note: L6 (niacinamide -> Instant Glow). PS05 clip 2.0-5.0 s, trimmed or 1.2x to fit: the cream melts in invisibly, the skin turns dewy and even with an Instant Glow, and she smiles. Keep the '4% NIACINAMIDE' pill and HUD over it.

shots.content: Odd AI split of two half-faces: she already glows in the 'before', with no visible difference.
shots.note: Client 00003293 'what is the difference. why is she glowing before hand'. Vertical half/half: left PS07_before_dull (no glow), right PS06_glow_after, labels 'BEFORE' / 'INSTANT GLOW'. Only 1.13 s, so retime: end S6 at 15.3 and hold the split 15.3-17.3, then start S8 at 17.3 (L7 starts 16.94; fine over the split).

shots.content: Creator at a cafe table holding the tube, under the SPF bubble 'SPF 50 PA+++ / MADE FOR INDIAN SKIN'.
shots.note: L7 'SPF 50 PA+++ handles the protection. That's my Instant Glow.' MEERA, glowing, holds the exact capped tube label-forward and smiles. Ends on a face with the product. Keep the SPF super.
